question: NJOM is related to TPUS in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, PLQO is related to VRWU. To which of the following is RNSQ related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For **NJOM → TPUS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af77a8b33200a4bb2805d8557686e9064cde1438c1945cbe9c0573de33a1687b.png] 

For **PLQO → VRWU**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d5616e2b0bfd236613c91e23646fa95ad0f3dbbc1ba442b0ca48c8070f8bed4.png] 

Similarly, for **RNSQ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37d8d697ff290f7334f8f0cb60e847afe8fcd0a112983318143da5788741807c.png] 

So, **RNSQ** will be related to **XTYW.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
